description: This file defines a final class LoggingFactory in the package org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.akka.logging. It serves as a factory for creating objects related to logging, specifically MdcEntry instances, and encapsulates the creation logic. The class is designed to prevent instantiation and only provides static methods.

classes.name: LoggingFactory
classes.description: A utility factory class for creating log-related objects, mainly MdcEntry instances, with an immutable and non-instantiable design.

methods.name: LoggingFactory()
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the utility class.
